text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so an all-female panel tells you essentially nothing about sex discrimination — if anything it cuts against it. Raising it would likely read as grasping and undermine your credibility on the points that actually matter.

The substantive issues are elsewhere. "Strong experience of digital media" against your fifteen years suggests they weighted a specific skillset over seniority — that may be a legitimate, if arguable, choice. If you suspect anything unfair, age is the more plausible angle, though eight years' experience doesn't make her young.

Chase the written explanation. A public broadcaster ignoring a feedback request for two weeks is the real failing — escalate to HR in writing.
